name: PLC Sim Test Bench
subtitle: Bottle fill & pack line - exercises every simulator instruction (educational).
notes: TEST PROJECT for the ladder simulation. To run: force ES1_Healthy, Guard_Closed and Auto_Sel ON, press Reset_PB, then Start_PB. Sim_Parts_SW makes bottles automatically. SAFETY: E-stop and safety functions must be hardwired or use rated safety relays (NFPA 79 / ISO 13849). The software is never the safety function.

rungs.comment: INIT 1/4: first scan only (Init_Done not yet set) - preload the tank level to 40.
INIT 2/4: default recipe = 1 (Recipe A, 3 s fill).
INIT 3/4: default fill time preset 3000 ms (used by T_Fill via preset tag).
INIT 4/4: latch Init_Done so the init rungs never run again (until Reset sim).

SAFETY OK seal-in: Reset_PB arms, ES1_Healthy and Guard_Closed must stay made. SAFETY: E-stop and safety functions must be hardwired or use rated safety relays (NFPA 79 / ISO 13849). The software is never the safety function.
Reset one-shot: Reset_PB gives a ONE-scan Reset_Pulse (ONS), no matter how long it is held.
Guard door lamp - uses ALIAS Guard_Door -> Guard_Closed (NC contact).
MODE: Auto when Auto_Sel on and Man_Sel off.
MODE: Manual when Man_Sel on and Auto_Sel off (both on = no mode).
LINE RUN seal-in: Start_PB starts, Stop_PB (NC logic) / safety / jam / leaving Auto drops it.
NEGATED COIL: Line_Idle is the inverse of the rung (on while Sys_Run is off).
MID-RUNG COIL: Run_Echo follows Sys_Run; Auto_Running needs Auto_Mode as well.
START WARNING: TON T_StartDelay 2 s after Sys_Run before conveyors move.
Start warning horn sounds while T_StartDelay is timing (.TT).
INFEED CONVEYOR (nested OR): auto after delay unless jammed (or bypassed) and case not full, OR manual jog.
OFF-DELAY: TOF T_RunOn keeps the outfeed running 3 s after the infeed stops.
Outfeed conveyor follows T_RunOn.DN (TOF done bit = on during run + 3 s after).
RETENTIVE: RTO T_RunHours accumulates infeed run time (1 h preset). Click it to reset.
Service lamp after 1 h of accumulated run time.
PART GENERATOR (test aid): with Sim_Parts_SW on, a pulse every 1.5 s while the infeed runs.
RISING EDGE: OSR gives Part_Pulse for one scan per bottle (photo-eye OR generator).
FALLING EDGE: OSF gives Eye_Clear_Pulse when the photo-eye clears.
Count photo-eye clears (proves the falling edge).
CTU C_Case: 6 bottles per case.
CTU C_Total: total bottles this shift.
Bottle_Count numeric mirror (ADD) for the math rungs.
LATCH: case full when C_Case done (OTL).
CASE INDEX: TON T_CaseIndex 2.5 s while the case is full.
Case pusher solenoid while indexing.
RES: index done resets C_Case.
UNLATCH: index done clears Case_Full (OTU).
Cases packed: ONS on Case_Full feeding CTU C_Cases.
Case done pulse (ONS) for the batch countdown.
LOAD: Load_Batch_PB (or Reset) loads C_Batch with 4 cases.
CTD: each finished case counts C_Batch down.
Batch complete lamp when C_Batch reaches 0 (CTD done = ACC <= 0).
Reset clears the shift counters.
JAM: photo-eye blocked 4 s while the infeed runs.
Jam alarm latch.
Jam alarm reset once the eye is clear.
TANK: fill valve open adds 4 % per pass (ADD).
TANK: each filled bottle / Drain_SW draws 3 % per pass (SUB).
Clamp: never below 0 (LES then MOV).
Clamp: never above 120 (GRT then MOV).
LES: low level below 20.
GEQ: high level at or above 90.
FILL CONTROL with hysteresis: start below 20, stop at 90, only while running.
LIM: level in the 20..80 band (Test, Low, High).
GRT: high-high above 110.
LEQ: low-low at or below 5 (only after init).
CPT: level in percent of the 120 % scale.
Recipe A select (ONS + MOV 1).
Recipe B select (ONS + MOV 2).
EQU: Recipe A active.
EQU: Recipe B active.
NEQ: a recipe is selected.
Recipe A fill time 3000 ms.
Recipe B fill time 6000 ms.
FILL TIMER: TON T_Fill uses preset TAG Fill_Time (changes with the recipe).
Filler valve open while T_Fill times.
Fill complete lamp.
MUL: litres x10 (0.5 L per bottle -> 5).
DIV: cases calculated from bottles.
STATUS: clear the word each pass.
bit0 = running (OR 1).
bit1 = jam (OR 2).
bit2 = level high (OR 4).
bit3 = manual (OR 8).
AND: low two bits.
XOR: flip the low nibble.
NOT: bitwise inverse.
MEQ: (Status_Word AND 3) = 1 -> running with no jam.
FLASHER 1/2: T_FlashOn 0.5 s (reset by T_FlashOff).
FLASHER 2/2: T_FlashOff 0.5 s - T_FlashOn.DN is a 1 Hz flash bit.
ANY ALARM: jam, high-high, low-low or safety lost.
Horn silence latch.
Reset clears horn silence.
Alarm horn until silenced.
RED lamp flashes on alarm.
AMBER lamp: manual, case indexing or start warning.
GREEN lamp: running with no alarm.
JSR Diagnostics every pass after init.
JSR Lube_Cycle only while the line runs (timers in it freeze when not called).

hmi_items.label: Status_Word / Status_Low / Status_Flip / Status_Inv - Status bits

program.plc_text:
Learning program for this cabinet. Not a download to a live PLC.
NOT A CERTIFIED UL 508A DRAWING. Design aid only.
Educational design aid only — real E-stop/safety functions must be hardwired or use rated safety relays per NFPA 79 / ISO 13849

PLC ladder (plain text you can copy into your real PLC programmer)
Symbols: [TAG]=NO contact  [/TAG]=NC contact  (TAG)=coil  (/TAG)=negated coil  TON/TOF/RTO=timer  CTU/CTD=counter  (RES C1)=reset  ONS/OSR/OSF=one-shot  nested OR / mid-rung coils supported
Real ladder order: Start NO seals with contactor NO, Stop NC and E-Stop NC in series, coil = contactor.

Rung 1 - INIT 1/4: first scan only (Init_Done not yet set) - preload the tank level to 40.
  |----[/Init_Done]----MOV[40→Tank_Level]----|
  Note:    INIT 1/4: first scan only (Init_Done not yet set) - preload the tank level to 40.

Rung 2 - INIT 2/4: default recipe = 1 (Recipe A, 3 s fill).
  |----[/Init_Done]----MOV[1→Recipe_No]----|
  Note:    INIT 2/4: default recipe = 1 (Recipe A, 3 s fill).

Rung 3 - INIT 3/4: default fill time preset 3000 ms (used by T_Fill via preset tag).
  |----[/Init_Done]----MOV[3000→Fill_Time]----|
  Note:    INIT 3/4: default fill time preset 3000 ms (used by T_Fill via preset tag).

Rung 4 - INIT 4/4: latch Init_Done so the init rungs never run again (until Reset sim).
  |----[/Init_Done]----(S)Init_Done----|
  Coil:    (Init_Done)
  Note:    INIT 4/4: latch Init_Done so the init rungs never run again (until Reset sim).

Rung 5 - SAFETY OK seal-in: Reset_PB arms, ES1_Healthy and Guard_Closed must stay made. SAFETY: E-stop and safety functions must be hardwired or use rated safety relays (NFPA 79 / ISO 13849). The software is never the safety function.
  |----([Reset_PB] OR [Safety_OK])----[ES1_Healthy]----[Guard_Closed]----(Safety_OK)----|
  Coil:    (Safety_OK)
  Note:    SAFETY OK seal-in: Reset_PB arms, ES1_Healthy and Guard_Closed must stay made. SAFETY: E-stop and safety functions must be hardwired or use rated safety relays (NFPA 79 / ISO 13849). The software is never the safety function.

Rung 6 - Reset one-shot: Reset_PB gives a ONE-scan Reset_Pulse (ONS), no matter how long it is held.
  |----[Reset_PB]----ONS[Reset_ONS]----(Reset_Pulse)----|
  Coil:    (Reset_Pulse)
  Note:    Reset one-shot: Reset_PB gives a ONE-scan Reset_Pulse (ONS), no matter how long it is held.

Rung 7 - Guard door lamp - uses ALIAS Guard_Door -> Guard_Closed (NC contact).
  |----[/Guard_Door]----(Guard_Open_Lamp)----|
  Contact: [/Guard_Door]  (NC)  Guard_Door (Device)
  Coil:    (Guard_Open_Lamp)  Guard_Open_Lamp (Device)
  Note:    Guard door lamp - uses ALIAS Guard_Door -> Guard_Closed (NC contact).

Rung 8 - MODE: Auto when Auto_Sel on and Man_Sel off.
  |----[Auto_Sel]----[/Man_Sel]----(Auto_Mode)----|
  Contact: [Auto_Sel]  (NO)  Auto_Sel (Device)
  Contact: [/Man_Sel]  (NC)  Man_Sel (Device)
  Coil:    (Auto_Mode)  Auto_Mode (Device)
  Note:    MODE: Auto when Auto_Sel on and Man_Sel off.

Rung 9 - MODE: Manual when Man_Sel on and Auto_Sel off (both on = no mode).
  |----[Man_Sel]----[/Auto_Sel]----(Man_Mode)----|
  Contact: [Man_Sel]  (NO)  Man_Sel (Device)
  Contact: [/Auto_Sel]  (NC)  Auto_Sel (Device)
  Coil:    (Man_Mode)  Man_Mode (Device)
  Note:    MODE: Manual when Man_Sel on and Auto_Sel off (both on = no mode).

Rung 10 - LINE RUN seal-in: Start_PB starts, Stop_PB (NC logic) / safety / jam / leaving Auto drops it.
  |----([Start_PB] OR [Sys_Run])----[/Stop_PB]----[Safety_OK]----[Auto_Mode]----[/Jam_Alarm]----(Sys_Run)----|
  Coil:    (Sys_Run)
  Note:    LINE RUN seal-in: Start_PB starts, Stop_PB (NC logic) / safety / jam / leaving Auto drops it.

Rung 11 - NEGATED COIL: Line_Idle is the inverse of the rung (on while Sys_Run is off).
  |----[Sys_Run]----(/Line_Idle)----|
  Contact: [Sys_Run]  (NO)  Sys_Run (Device)
  Coil:    (/Line_Idle)  Line_Idle (Device)
  Note:    NEGATED COIL: Line_Idle is the inverse of the rung (on while Sys_Run is off).

Rung 12 - MID-RUNG COIL: Run_Echo follows Sys_Run; Auto_Running needs Auto_Mode as well.
  |----[Sys_Run]----(Run_Echo)----[Auto_Mode]----(Auto_Running)----|
  Mid-coils: Run_Echo
  Coil:    (Auto_Running)
  Note:    MID-RUNG COIL: Run_Echo follows Sys_Run; Auto_Running needs Auto_Mode as well.

Rung 13 - START WARNING: TON T_StartDelay 2 s after Sys_Run before conveyors move.
  |----[Sys_Run]----TON[T_StartDelay/2000ms]----|
  Contact: [Sys_Run]  (NO)  Sys_Run (Device)
  Timer:   TON(T_StartDelay) PT=2000ms
  Note:    START WARNING: TON T_StartDelay 2 s after Sys_Run before conveyors move.

Rung 14 - Start warning horn sounds while T_StartDelay is timing (.TT).
  |----[T_StartDelay.TT]----(Start_Warn_Horn)----|
  Contact: [T_StartDelay.TT]  (NO)  T_StartDelay.TT (Device)
  Coil:    (Start_Warn_Horn)  Start_Warn_Horn (Device)
  Note:    Start warning horn sounds while T_StartDelay is timing (.TT).

Rung 15 - INFEED CONVEYOR (nested OR): auto after delay unless jammed (or bypassed) and case not full, OR manual jog.
  |----([T_StartDelay.DN]+([/Jam_Alarm] OR [Jam_Bypass_SW])+[/Case_Full] OR [Man_Mode]+[Jog_PB])----(Conv1_Run)----|
  Coil:    (Conv1_Run)
  Note:    INFEED CONVEYOR (nested OR): auto after delay unless jammed (or bypassed) and case not full, OR manual jog.

Rung 16 - OFF-DELAY: TOF T_RunOn keeps the outfeed running 3 s after the infeed stops.
  |----[Conv1_Run]----TOF[T_RunOn/3000ms]----|
  Contact: [Conv1_Run]  (NO)  Conv1_Run (Device)
  Timer:   TOF(T_RunOn) PT=3000ms
  Note:    OFF-DELAY: TOF T_RunOn keeps the outfeed running 3 s after the infeed stops.

Rung 17 - Outfeed conveyor follows T_RunOn.DN (TOF done bit = on during run + 3 s after).
  |----[T_RunOn.DN]----(Conv2_Run)----|
  Contact: [T_RunOn.DN]  (NO)  T_RunOn.DN (Device)
  Coil:    (Conv2_Run)  Conv2_Run (Device)
  Note:    Outfeed conveyor follows T_RunOn.DN (TOF done bit = on during run + 3 s after).

Rung 18 - RETENTIVE: RTO T_RunHours accumulates infeed run time (1 h preset). Click it to reset.
  |----[Conv1_Run]----RTO[T_RunHours/3600000ms]----|
  Contact: [Conv1_Run]  (NO)  Conv1_Run (Device)
  Timer:   RTO(T_RunHours) PT=3600000ms
  Note:    RETENTIVE: RTO T_RunHours accumulates infeed run time (1 h preset). Click it to reset.

Rung 19 - Service lamp after 1 h of accumulated run time.
  |----[T_RunHours.DN]----(Service_Due_Lamp)----|
  Contact: [T_RunHours.DN]  (NO)  T_RunHours.DN (Device)
  Coil:    (Service_Due_Lamp)  Service_Due_Lamp (Device)
  Note:    Service lamp after 1 h of accumulated run time.

Rung 20 - PART GENERATOR (test aid): with Sim_Parts_SW on, a pulse every 1.5 s while the infeed runs.
  |----[Sim_Parts_SW]----[Conv1_Run]----[/T_PartGen.DN]----TON[T_PartGen/1500ms]----|
  Contact: [Sim_Parts_SW]  (NO)  Sim_Parts_SW (Device)
  Contact: [Conv1_Run]  (NO)  Conv1_Run (Device)
  Contact: [/T_PartGen.DN]  (NC)  T_PartGen.DN (Device)
  Timer:   TON(T_PartGen) PT=1500ms
  Note:    PART GENERATOR (test aid): with Sim_Parts_SW on, a pulse every 1.5 s while the infeed runs.

Rung 21 - RISING EDGE: OSR gives Part_Pulse for one scan per bottle (photo-eye OR generator).
  |----([Part_Eye] OR [T_PartGen.DN])----OSR[Eye_OSR→Part_Pulse]----|
  Note:    RISING EDGE: OSR gives Part_Pulse for one scan per bottle (photo-eye OR generator).

Rung 22 - FALLING EDGE: OSF gives Eye_Clear_Pulse when the photo-eye clears.
  |----[Part_Eye]----OSF[Eye_OSF→Eye_Clear_Pulse]----|
  Note:    FALLING EDGE: OSF gives Eye_Clear_Pulse when the photo-eye clears.

Rung 23 - Count photo-eye clears (proves the falling edge).
  |----[Eye_Clear_Pulse]----CTU[C_EyeClears/PRE=9999]----|
  Contact: [Eye_Clear_Pulse]  (NO)  Eye_Clear_Pulse (Device)
  Counter: CTU(C_EyeClears) PRE=9999  DN when ACC>=PRE
  Note:    Count photo-eye clears (proves the falling edge).

Rung 24 - CTU C_Case: 6 bottles per case.
  |----[Part_Pulse]----CTU[C_Case/PRE=6]----|
  Contact: [Part_Pulse]  (NO)  Part_Pulse (Device)
  Counter: CTU(C_Case) PRE=6  DN when ACC>=PRE
  Note:    CTU C_Case: 6 bottles per case.

Rung 25 - CTU C_Total: total bottles this shift.
  |----[Part_Pulse]----CTU[C_Total/PRE=9999]----|
  Contact: [Part_Pulse]  (NO)  Part_Pulse (Device)
  Counter: CTU(C_Total) PRE=9999  DN when ACC>=PRE
  Note:    CTU C_Total: total bottles this shift.

Rung 26 - Bottle_Count numeric mirror (ADD) for the math rungs.
  |----[Part_Pulse]----ADD[Bottle_Count=Bottle_Count,1]----|
  Note:    Bottle_Count numeric mirror (ADD) for the math rungs.

Rung 27 - LATCH: case full when C_Case done (OTL).
  |----[C_Case.DN]----(S)Case_Full----|
  Coil:    (Case_Full)
  Note:    LATCH: case full when C_Case done (OTL).

Rung 28 - CASE INDEX: TON T_CaseIndex 2.5 s while the case is full.
  |----[Case_Full]----TON[T_CaseIndex/2500ms]----|
  Contact: [Case_Full]  (NO)  Case_Full (Device)
  Timer:   TON(T_CaseIndex) PT=2500ms
  Note:    CASE INDEX: TON T_CaseIndex 2.5 s while the case is full.

Rung 29 - Case pusher solenoid while indexing.
  |----[Case_Full]----[/T_CaseIndex.DN]----(Case_Pusher)----|
  Contact: [Case_Full]  (NO)  Case_Full (Device)
  Contact: [/T_CaseIndex.DN]  (NC)  T_CaseIndex.DN (Device)
  Coil:    (Case_Pusher)  Case_Pusher (Device)
  Note:    Case pusher solenoid while indexing.

Rung 30 - RES: index done resets C_Case.
  |----[T_CaseIndex.DN]----(RES C_Case)----|
  Contact: [T_CaseIndex.DN]  (NO)  T_CaseIndex.DN (Device)
  Counter: RES(C_Case)  ACC:=0
  Note:    RES: index done resets C_Case.

Rung 31 - UNLATCH: index done clears Case_Full (OTU).
  |----[T_CaseIndex.DN]----(R)Case_Full----|
  Coil:    (Case_Full)
  Note:    UNLATCH: index done clears Case_Full (OTU).

Rung 32 - Cases packed: ONS on Case_Full feeding CTU C_Cases.
  |----[Case_Full]----ONS[Case_ONS]----CTU[C_Cases/PRE=9999]----|
  Note:    Cases packed: ONS on Case_Full feeding CTU C_Cases.

Rung 33 - Case done pulse (ONS) for the batch countdown.
  |----[T_CaseIndex.DN]----ONS[CaseDone_ONS]----(Case_Done_Pulse)----|
  Coil:    (Case_Done_Pulse)
  Note:    Case done pulse (ONS) for the batch countdown.

Rung 34 - LOAD: Load_Batch_PB (or Reset) loads C_Batch with 4 cases.
  |----[Load_Batch_PB]----+----(LOAD C_Batch)----|
  |----[Reset_Pulse]  ----+                     |
  Contact: [Load_Batch_PB]  (NO)  Load_Batch_PB (Device)
  Contact: [Reset_Pulse]  (NO)  Reset_Pulse (Device)
  Counter: LOAD(C_Batch)  ACC:=PRE
  Note:    LOAD: Load_Batch_PB (or Reset) loads C_Batch with 4 cases.

Rung 35 - CTD: each finished case counts C_Batch down.
  |----[Case_Done_Pulse]----CTD[C_Batch/PRE=4]----|
  Contact: [Case_Done_Pulse]  (NO)  Case_Done_Pulse (Device)
  Counter: CTD(C_Batch) PRE=4  DN when ACC<=0
  Note:    CTD: each finished case counts C_Batch down.

Rung 36 - Batch complete lamp when C_Batch reaches 0 (CTD done = ACC <= 0).
  |----[C_Batch.DN]----[Init_Done]----(Batch_Done_Lamp)----|
  Contact: [C_Batch.DN]  (NO)  C_Batch.DN (Device)
  Contact: [Init_Done]  (NO)  Init_Done (Device)
  Coil:    (Batch_Done_Lamp)  Batch_Done_Lamp (Device)
  Note:    Batch complete lamp when C_Batch reaches 0 (CTD done = ACC <= 0).

Rung 37 - Reset clears the shift counters.
  |----[Reset_Pulse]----(RES C_Total)----|
  Contact: [Reset_Pulse]  (NO)  Reset_Pulse (Device)
  Counter: RES(C_Total)  ACC:=0
  Note:    Reset clears the shift counters.

Rung 38 - JAM: photo-eye blocked 4 s while the infeed runs.
  |----[Part_Eye]----[Conv1_Run]----TON[T_Jam/4000ms]----|
  Contact: [Part_Eye]  (NO)  Part_Eye (Device)
  Contact: [Conv1_Run]  (NO)  Conv1_Run (Device)
  Timer:   TON(T_Jam) PT=4000ms
  Note:    JAM: photo-eye blocked 4 s while the infeed runs.

Rung 39 - Jam alarm latch.
  |----[T_Jam.DN]----(S)Jam_Alarm----|
  Coil:    (Jam_Alarm)
  Note:    Jam alarm latch.

Rung 40 - Jam alarm reset once the eye is clear.
  |----[Reset_Pulse]----[/Part_Eye]----(R)Jam_Alarm----|
  Coil:    (Jam_Alarm)
  Note:    Jam alarm reset once the eye is clear.

Rung 41 - TANK: fill valve open adds 4 % per pass (ADD).
  |----[Fill_Valve]----ADD[Tank_Level=Tank_Level,4]----|
  Note:    TANK: fill valve open adds 4 % per pass (ADD).

Rung 42 - TANK: each filled bottle / Drain_SW draws 3 % per pass (SUB).
  |----([Filler_Valve] OR [Drain_SW])----SUB[Tank_Level=Tank_Level,3]----|
  Note:    TANK: each filled bottle / Drain_SW draws 3 % per pass (SUB).

Rung 43 - Clamp: never below 0 (LES then MOV).
  |----LES[Tank_Level,0]----MOV[0→Tank_Level]----|
  Note:    Clamp: never below 0 (LES then MOV).

Rung 44 - Clamp: never above 120 (GRT then MOV).
  |----GRT[Tank_Level,120]----MOV[120→Tank_Level]----|
  Note:    Clamp: never above 120 (GRT then MOV).

Rung 45 - LES: low level below 20.
  |----LES[Tank_Level,20]----(Level_Low)----|
  Coil:    (Level_Low)
  Note:    LES: low level below 20.

Rung 46 - GEQ: high level at or above 90.
  |----GEQ[Tank_Level,90]----(Level_High)----|
  Coil:    (Level_High)
  Note:    GEQ: high level at or above 90.

Rung 47 - FILL CONTROL with hysteresis: start below 20, stop at 90, only while running.
  |----([Level_Low] OR [Fill_Valve])----[/Level_High]----[Sys_Run]----(Fill_Valve)----|
  Coil:    (Fill_Valve)
  Note:    FILL CONTROL with hysteresis: start below 20, stop at 90, only while running.

Rung 48 - LIM: level in the 20..80 band (Test, Low, High).
  |----LIM[Tank_Level,20,80]----(Level_In_Band)----|
  Coil:    (Level_In_Band)
  Note:    LIM: level in the 20..80 band (Test, Low, High).

Rung 49 - GRT: high-high above 110.
  |----GRT[Tank_Level,110]----(Level_HiHi)----|
  Coil:    (Level_HiHi)
  Note:    GRT: high-high above 110.

Rung 50 - LEQ: low-low at or below 5 (only after init).
  |----[Init_Done]----LEQ[Tank_Level,5]----(Level_LoLo)----|
  Coil:    (Level_LoLo)
  Note:    LEQ: low-low at or below 5 (only after init).

Rung 51 - CPT: level in percent of the 120 % scale.
  |----[Init_Done]----CPT[Level_Pct=(Tank_Level * 100) / 120]----|
  Note:    CPT: level in percent of the 120 % scale.

Rung 52 - Recipe A select (ONS + MOV 1).
  |----[Recipe_A_PB]----ONS[RecA_ONS]----MOV[1→Recipe_No]----|
  Note:    Recipe A select (ONS + MOV 1).

Rung 53 - Recipe B select (ONS + MOV 2).
  |----[Recipe_B_PB]----ONS[RecB_ONS]----MOV[2→Recipe_No]----|
  Note:    Recipe B select (ONS + MOV 2).

Rung 54 - EQU: Recipe A active.
  |----EQU[Recipe_No,1]----(Recipe_A)----|
  Coil:    (Recipe_A)
  Note:    EQU: Recipe A active.

Rung 55 - EQU: Recipe B active.
  |----EQU[Recipe_No,2]----(Recipe_B)----|
  Coil:    (Recipe_B)
  Note:    EQU: Recipe B active.

Rung 56 - NEQ: a recipe is selected.
  |----NEQ[Recipe_No,0]----(Recipe_Valid)----|
  Coil:    (Recipe_Valid)
  Note:    NEQ: a recipe is selected.

Rung 57 - Recipe A fill time 3000 ms.
  |----[Recipe_A]----MOV[3000→Fill_Time]----|
  Note:    Recipe A fill time 3000 ms.

Rung 58 - Recipe B fill time 6000 ms.
  |----[Recipe_B]----MOV[6000→Fill_Time]----|
  Note:    Recipe B fill time 6000 ms.

Rung 59 - FILL TIMER: TON T_Fill uses preset TAG Fill_Time (changes with the recipe).
  |----[Bottle_In_Place]----[Sys_Run]----[Recipe_Valid]----TON[T_Fill/PT=Fill_Time]----|
  Note:    FILL TIMER: TON T_Fill uses preset TAG Fill_Time (changes with the recipe).

Rung 60 - Filler valve open while T_Fill times.
  |----[T_Fill.TT]----(Filler_Valve)----|
  Contact: [T_Fill.TT]  (NO)  T_Fill.TT (Device)
  Coil:    (Filler_Valve)  Filler_Valve (Device)
  Note:    Filler valve open while T_Fill times.

Rung 61 - Fill complete lamp.
  |----[T_Fill.DN]----(Fill_Complete_Lamp)----|
  Contact: [T_Fill.DN]  (NO)  T_Fill.DN (Device)
  Coil:    (Fill_Complete_Lamp)  Fill_Complete_Lamp (Device)
  Note:    Fill complete lamp.

Rung 62 - MUL: litres x10 (0.5 L per bottle -> 5).
  |----[Init_Done]----MUL[Litres_x10=Bottle_Count,5]----|
  Note:    MUL: litres x10 (0.5 L per bottle -> 5).

Rung 63 - DIV: cases calculated from bottles.
  |----[Init_Done]----DIV[Cases_Calc=Bottle_Count,6]----|
  Note:    DIV: cases calculated from bottles.

Rung 64 - STATUS: clear the word each pass.
  |----[Init_Done]----MOV[0→Status_Word]----|
  Note:    STATUS: clear the word each pass.

Rung 65 - bit0 = running (OR 1).
  |----[Sys_Run]----OR[Status_Word=Status_Word,1]----|
  Note:    bit0 = running (OR 1).

Rung 66 - bit1 = jam (OR 2).
  |----[Jam_Alarm]----OR[Status_Word=Status_Word,2]----|
  Note:    bit1 = jam (OR 2).

Rung 67 - bit2 = level high (OR 4).
  |----[Level_High]----OR[Status_Word=Status_Word,4]----|
  Note:    bit2 = level high (OR 4).

Rung 68 - bit3 = manual (OR 8).
  |----[Man_Mode]----OR[Status_Word=Status_Word,8]----|
  Note:    bit3 = manual (OR 8).

Rung 69 - AND: low two bits.
  |----[Init_Done]----AND[Status_Low=Status_Word,3]----|
  Note:    AND: low two bits.

Rung 70 - XOR: flip the low nibble.
  |----[Init_Done]----XOR[Status_Flip=Status_Word,15]----|
  Note:    XOR: flip the low nibble.

Rung 71 - NOT: bitwise inverse.
  |----[Init_Done]----NOT[Status_Inv=~Status_Word]----|
  Note:    NOT: bitwise inverse.

Rung 72 - MEQ: (Status_Word AND 3) = 1 -> running with no jam.
  |----MEQ[Status_Word,3,1]----(Running_No_Jam)----|
  Coil:    (Running_No_Jam)
  Note:    MEQ: (Status_Word AND 3) = 1 -> running with no jam.

Rung 73 - FLASHER 1/2: T_FlashOn 0.5 s (reset by T_FlashOff).
  |----[/T_FlashOff.DN]----TON[T_FlashOn/500ms]----|
  Contact: [/T_FlashOff.DN]  (NC)  T_FlashOff.DN (Device)
  Timer:   TON(T_FlashOn) PT=500ms
  Note:    FLASHER 1/2: T_FlashOn 0.5 s (reset by T_FlashOff).

Rung 74 - FLASHER 2/2: T_FlashOff 0.5 s - T_FlashOn.DN is a 1 Hz flash bit.
  |----[T_FlashOn.DN]----TON[T_FlashOff/500ms]----|
  Contact: [T_FlashOn.DN]  (NO)  T_FlashOn.DN (Device)
  Timer:   TON(T_FlashOff) PT=500ms
  Note:    FLASHER 2/2: T_FlashOff 0.5 s - T_FlashOn.DN is a 1 Hz flash bit.

Rung 75 - ANY ALARM: jam, high-high, low-low or safety lost.
  |----[Jam_Alarm] ----+----(Any_Alarm)----|
  |----[Level_HiHi]----+                  |
  |----[Level_LoLo]----+                  |
  |----[/Safety_OK]----+                  |
  Contact: [Jam_Alarm]  (NO)  Jam_Alarm (Device)
  Contact: [Level_HiHi]  (NO)  Level_HiHi (Device)
  Contact: [Level_LoLo]  (NO)  Level_LoLo (Device)
  Contact: [/Safety_OK]  (NC)  Safety_OK (Device)
  Coil:    (Any_Alarm)  Any_Alarm (Device)
  Note:    ANY ALARM: jam, high-high, low-low or safety lost.

Rung 76 - Horn silence latch.
  |----[Silence_PB]----(S)Horn_Silenced----|
  Coil:    (Horn_Silenced)
  Note:    Horn silence latch.

Rung 77 - Reset clears horn silence.
  |----[Reset_Pulse]----(R)Horn_Silenced----|
  Coil:    (Horn_Silenced)
  Note:    Reset clears horn silence.

Rung 78 - Alarm horn until silenced.
  |----[Any_Alarm]----[/Horn_Silenced]----(Alarm_Horn)----|
  Contact: [Any_Alarm]  (NO)  Any_Alarm (Device)
  Contact: [/Horn_Silenced]  (NC)  Horn_Silenced (Device)
  Coil:    (Alarm_Horn)  Alarm_Horn (Device)
  Note:    Alarm horn until silenced.

Rung 79 - RED lamp flashes on alarm.
  |----[Any_Alarm]----[T_FlashOn.DN]----(Lamp_Red)----|
  Contact: [Any_Alarm]  (NO)  Any_Alarm (Device)
  Contact: [T_FlashOn.DN]  (NO)  T_FlashOn.DN (Device)
  Coil:    (Lamp_Red)  Lamp_Red (Device)
  Note:    RED lamp flashes on alarm.

Rung 80 - AMBER lamp: manual, case indexing or start warning.
  |----[Man_Mode]       ----+----(Lamp_Amber)----|
  |----[Case_Full]      ----+                   |
  |----[Start_Warn_Horn]----+                   |
  Contact: [Man_Mode]  (NO)  Man_Mode (Device)
  Contact: [Case_Full]  (NO)  Case_Full (Device)
  Contact: [Start_Warn_Horn]  (NO)  Start_Warn_Horn (Device)
  Coil:    (Lamp_Amber)  Lamp_Amber (Device)
  Note:    AMBER lamp: manual, case indexing or start warning.

Rung 81 - GREEN lamp: running with no alarm.
  |----[Sys_Run]----[/Any_Alarm]----(Lamp_Green)----|
  Contact: [Sys_Run]  (NO)  Sys_Run (Device)
  Contact: [/Any_Alarm]  (NC)  Any_Alarm (Device)
  Coil:    (Lamp_Green)  Lamp_Green (Device)
  Note:    GREEN lamp: running with no alarm.

Rung 82 - JSR Diagnostics every pass after init.
  |----[Init_Done]----jsr----|
  Note:    JSR Diagnostics every pass after init.

Rung 83 - JSR Lube_Cycle only while the line runs (timers in it freeze when not called).
  |----[Sys_Run]----jsr----|
  Note:    JSR Lube_Cycle only while the line runs (timers in it freeze when not called).
program.hmi_text:
Learning program for this cabinet. Not a download to a live PLC.

HMI screens and indicators (edit the names, then copy into your HMI software)

Screen: Main
  - [screen] OVERVIEW screen
  - [indicator] Lamp_Green - Running (green)
  - [indicator] Lamp_Amber - Manual / indexing / warning (amber)
  - [indicator] Lamp_Red - Alarm (red, flashing)
  - [indicator] Line_Idle - Line idle
  - [button] Start_PB - START
  - [button] Stop_PB - STOP
  - [button] Reset_PB - RESET
  - [button] Silence_PB - SILENCE HORN
  - [selector] Auto_Sel / Man_Sel - MODE
  - [screen] PRODUCTION screen
  - [numeric] C_Case.ACC - Bottles in case (of 6)
  - [numeric] C_Total.ACC - Bottles this shift
  - [numeric] C_Cases.ACC - Cases packed
  - [numeric] C_Batch.ACC - Cases left in batch
  - [numeric] Litres_x10 / Cases_Calc - Production math
  - [button] Load_Batch_PB - LOAD BATCH
  - [indicator] Batch_Done_Lamp - Batch complete
  - [screen] TANK & RECIPE screen
  - [bargraph] Tank_Level / Level_Pct - Tank level
  - [indicator] Fill_Valve - Filling
  - [indicator] Level_Low / Level_High / Level_In_Band
  - [button] Recipe_A_PB - RECIPE A (3 s)
  - [button] Recipe_B_PB - RECIPE B (6 s)
  - [numeric] Recipe_No / Fill_Time - Active recipe
  - [numeric] T_Fill.ACC - Fill progress
  - [screen] MAINTENANCE screen
  - [numeric] T_RunHours.ACC - Run hours (RTO)
  - [indicator] Service_Due_Lamp - Service due
  - [numeric] C_LubeShots.ACC - Lube shots
  - [indicator] Grease_Low_Lamp - Grease low
  - [numeric] Status_Word / Status_Low / Status_Flip / Status_Inv - Status bits
  - [indicator] Heartbeat - PLC heartbeat
  - [screen] ALARMS screen
  - [alarm] Jam_Alarm - Infeed jam
  - [alarm] Level_HiHi - Tank high-high
  - [alarm] Level_LoLo - Tank low-low
  - [alarm] Safety_OK off - Safety circuit open
  - [indicator] Guard_Open_Lamp - Guard open

tag_descriptions.ES1_Healthy: E-stop circuit healthy (safety relay feedback) - FORCE ON to run
tag_descriptions.Guard_Closed: Guard door closed switch - FORCE ON to run
tag_descriptions.Fill_Time: Fill time preset ms (T_Fill preset tag)

Diagnostics.comment: EARLY RET when Diag_Enable is off (rungs below are skipped).

Lube_Cycle.comment: Lube pump on during the pulse.

Lube_Count.comment: CTU C_LubeShots (ONS so one count per pulse).
